title: nf-core/sarek pipeline parameters
description: An open-source analysis pipeline to detect germline or somatic variants from whole genome or targeted sequencing

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.title: Sample sheet (CSV)
input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

schemaResolved.title: SAREK Pipeline - Sample Sheet Schema
schemaResolved.description: Schema for the sample sheet file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must start with alphanumeric character, contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores, and be 1-50 characters long

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
fastq_1.description: Path to FastQ file containing forward reads (R1)

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2, optional, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
fastq_2.description: Path to FastQ file containing reverse reads (R2)

errorMessage.additionalProperties: Only required properties are: sample, fastq_1

errorMessage.minItems: Sample sheet must contain at least one sample

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

organism.title: Organism
organism.description: Select your organism to use the appropriate reference files (Default: yeast).

s3_bucket.title: S3 bucket (no s3:// prefix)
s3_bucket.description: AWS S3 bucket name used for reference and output paths.
